name: paperone
description: PaperOne literature search, library and PDFs with source-grounded paper reading and research cards.

interface.shortDescription: Find papers, read PDFs and create research cards.
interface.longDescription: Search by DOI, arXiv, title or keywords; manage your library and download PDFs. Read papers with source anchors or create evidence-grounded research cards using bundled Nature Skills.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find papers in PaperOne and show their metadata and PDF availability.
